from tasks.t0054_minimal_dsgc_ampa_nmda_scalar_gaba.code.run_tuning_curve import setup_sweep_artifacts
from tasks.t0054_minimal_dsgc_ampa_nmda_scalar_gaba.code.constants import TrialMode
from tasks.t0054_minimal_dsgc_ampa_nmda_scalar_gaba.code.trial import run_one_trial

artifacts = setup_sweep_artifacts()
# First inert check: weights at construction time.
first_pair = artifacts.pairs[0]
print(f'[inert-check] first_pair.nmda_netcon.weight[0] = {float(first_pair.nmda_netcon.weight[0])} uS', flush=True)
assert float(first_pair.nmda_netcon.weight[0]) == 0.0, 'NMDA NetCon weight should be 0 at construction'
print('[inert-check] PASS: NMDA NetCon weights are 0.0 after build_ei_pairs', flush=True)

from neuron import h
expected_t0052_rate = 0.666667
for trial_idx in range(2):
    trial_seed = 1000 * 0 + trial_idx + 1
    r = run_one_trial(
        h=h,
        cell=artifacts.cell,
        pairs=artifacts.pairs,
        mode=TrialMode.FULL,
        angle_deg=0.0,
        trial_seed=trial_seed,
        gnmda_ns=0.0,
    )
    diff = abs(r.firing_rate_hz - expected_t0052_rate)
    print(f'[inert-sim] trial_seed={trial_seed} t0054_rate={r.firing_rate_hz:.6f} Hz t0052_rate={expected_t0052_rate:.6f} Hz diff={diff:.3e} Hz', flush=True)
    assert diff < 1e-6, f'gNMDA=0 mismatch at trial_seed={trial_seed}: diff={diff}'
print('[inert-sim] PASS: gNMDA=0 FULL theta=0 matches t0052 within 1e-6 Hz', flush=True)
